proof_summary: Take \(N=28996592704045424640=2^{13}3^6\cdot5\cdot7^6\cdot13^4\cdot17^2\). Multiplicativity gives \(\sigma(N)=140078688585537333726=2\cdot3^2\cdot29\cdot43\cdot127\cdot307\cdot1093\cdot4733\cdot30941\), and replacing each prime power \(p^e\) by \((p-1)^e\) yields exactly \(N\), making this unlisted positive number a fixed point.
